description: This file defines a Java interface named GroupDao for data access operations related to Group entities. It extends a generic DAO interface and declares methods for retrieving groups by permissions, by group type, and by IDs.

classes.name: GroupDao
classes.description: An interface for accessing and managing Group data in the persistence layer, providing methods to retrieve groups based on permissions, type, and IDs.

methods.name: getGroupsListBypermissions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects that have permissions matching the provided set of permission IDs.

methods.name: listGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects filtered by the specified GroupType.

methods.name: listGroupByIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects corresponding to the provided set of Group IDs.
